note: Adapted from the species-level description in Ahmad 1965, Termites of Thailand (Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History 131), the original in English; the source pack contains only the descriptions and measurements of the major and minor soldiers (Figs. 35, 36), while the alate and the worker appear only as citations in the synonymy list (Ahmad, 1958) and are not described in the pack.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier (Fig. 35): head pale reddish brown, a small area around the frontal gland (fontanelle) brown; postclypeus slightly darker than the head capsule; labrum reddish brown; antennae brown; mandibles dark brown; pronotum yellowish brown, the mesonotum, metanotum and abdominal tergites slightly paler than the pronotum; legs pale. Head sparsely hairy; labrum with long setae on both sides and at the base of the hyaline tip; postmentum with 2 pairs of setae near the anterior end; pronotum with a few short hairs along the anterior margin and several setae on the disc. Head markedly narrowing anteriorly, the posterior width about 1.5 times the anterior width; fontanelle minute, circular, situated in the anterior half of the head. Compound eyes dot-like, circular, whitish. Labrum dome-shaped, widest before the posterior half; tip hyaline, trilobed, the median lobe extremely produced forwards. Mandibles long, sabre-shaped, curved at the tips; left mandible with 3 obtuse tooth-like notches at the base; right mandible without notches. Postmentum long and narrow, slightly arched, the lateral margins almost parallel in the middle. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 twice as long as segment 2 and 1.5 times as long as segments 4 and 5. Pronotum about twice as wide as long; anterior margin with an indistinct median notch; lateral angles narrowly rounded; posterior margin moderately concave. Mesonotal lateral lobes angular; posterior margin slightly concave. Metanotum wider than the pronotum; lateral lobes angular; posterior margin almost straight.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Minor soldier (Fig. 36): head yellowish brown; labrum and antennae brown; mandibles reddish brown; thorax and abdomen paler than the head. Head hairless, labrum with long setae on both sides; postmentum with 2 setae at the distal end; pronotum with short hairs along the anterior margin and several long setae on the disc; mesonotum and metanotum with several long setae directed backwards. Head nearly rectangular, narrowing anteriorly; fontanelle minute, circular, situated in the anterior half. Compound eyes dot-like. Labrum longer than wide; sides slightly convex; tip hyaline, triangular, the median lobe extremely produced forwards. Mandibles long and slender. Postmentum long, slightly arched; the waist lies closer to the widest part and farther from the posterior margin. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 2 shorter than segment 3; segment 4 as long as segment 3. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both indistinctly concave; lateral lobes narrowly rounded, slightly produced forwards. Mesonotum and metanotum angularly produced laterally.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm, mean in parentheses). Major soldier, 10 individuals: head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 4.81—5.20 (4.96); head width (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 2.34—2.54 (2.44); head width (to the posterior lateral end of the antennal carina) 3.19—3.53 (3.35); maximum head width 3.79—4.21 (4.00); left mandible length 2.60—2.96 (2.78); postmentum length 2.86—3.32 (3.16); postmentum maximum width 0.93—1.09 (0.96); postmentum minimum width 0.62—0.67 (0.66); pronotum length 1.19—1.40 (1.32); pronotum width 2.46—2.75 (2.59); mesonotal width 2.02—2.23 (2.11); metanotal width 2.18—2.49 (2.32). Minor soldier, 10 individuals: head length (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 2.86—3.27 (3.03); head width (to the lateral base of the mandibles) 1.35—1.50 (1.44); head width (to the posterior lateral end of the antennal carina) 1.92—2.18 (1.99); maximum head width 2.23—2.54 (2.33); left mandible length 0.90—1.04 (0.96); postmentum length 1.87—2.08 (1.98); postmentum maximum width 0.57—0.67 (0.61); postmentum minimum width 0.41—0.52 (0.46); pronotum length 0.90—1.04 (0.96); pronotum width 1.56—1.66 (1.61); mesonotal width 1.24—1.35 (1.30); metanotal width 1.42—1.56 (1.48).
